text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —One night, as the 'Japanese Derby' drew near.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet...
This ain't nearly enough at all...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Calling it reckless, saying it's impossible...!
I won't let anyone ever say that again...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Push it even closer to the limit...!
I'm gonna do this...!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Uryaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......It's steadily gaining momentum.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (And to an abnormal degree, at that.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, you've definitely gotta watch it live at the track this year!
Seeing how far Vodka can hold her own against the top contenders from the Satsuki Sho is gonna be quite the show!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, but I really think Vodka has a shot.
She feels kinda different from the Umamusume
who usually run the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a sucker for hype, y'know~.
Whenever people talk about a historic achievement, I can't help but get my hopes up~."

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
People kept saying it was reckless, but there are actually quite a few people rooting for it, right?
I'd love to witness a historic moment myself!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's about time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The battle to determine the pinnacle of the generation, the Nippon Derby,
which I finally reached together with Dream Journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We've done everything we possibly could up to today.
All that's left to do is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Just like Stay Gold, whom she admires.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I simply prayed that Dream Journey could face the 'storm' that might appear today with a smile on her face."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How can you speak of it as if it's someone else's problem?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Mark my words, Trainer.
A "storm" is bound to come today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, shall we not enjoy ourselves?
............Together.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Now then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(It's as if frenzy and tension
are swirling together into a vortex.
So this is the 'Japanese Derby'――)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (This immense pressure is—)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Journey-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll be... in your care today!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (――Magnificent.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(How long has it been...
since I broke into a cold sweat like this—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(My instincts are screaming at me.
The being in front of me is beyond all common sense...!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (...I wonder if Big Sis felt the same way back then—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to working with you, Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Now... into the "storm" I go—)
